summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Annual General Meeting statements for April 28, 2026. The chair and CEO's remarks address the bank's return to full private ownership in May 2025, financial performance, dividend increases (32.5p per share, +51% YoY), share buybacks (£750m each in July and at FY results), and the acquisition of Evelyn Partners (no terms provided). This is a routine shareholder communication, not a special-situation triggering event. No special category applies.
